writer.name: get_document_content
writer.description: Get document (or selection/range) content. Result includes document_length. scope: full, selection, or range (requires start, end).

writer.name: apply_document_content
writer.description: Insert or replace content. To replace the ENTIRE document use target='full_document' with content only. Use target='search' with old_content for find-and-replace of a specific substring only.

writer.name: search_in_document
writer.description: Search for text ANYWHERE in the document (body, tables, frames, comments). Each match reports where it lives.

writer.name: add_comment
writer.description: Add a comment/annotation anchored to text matching search.

writer.name: apply_style
writer.description: Apply a paragraph or character style (family='ParagraphStyles' or 'CharacterStyles').

writer.name: get_document_tree
writer.description: Return the heading/outline tree of the document.

writer.name: set_selection
writer.description: Set the current selection to a character range or search hit.

writer.name: get_guidance
writer.description: Read one how-to manual topic (search, navigation, images, …).

draw.name: get_draw_tree
draw.description: Returns semantic tree (DOM) of shapes. Use for verifying flowcharts, connections, hierarchy without screenshots.

draw.name: shape_upsert
draw.description: Create or edit a shape on the draw page. Returns shape and status.

draw.name: shape_connect
draw.description: Connect two shapes on the same page with a connector.

draw.name: shape_summary
draw.description: Flat summary of shapes on the page (index, type, geometry, text).

draw.name: add_slide
draw.description: Add a slide or draw page.

calc.name: get_sheet_summary
calc.description: Returns a comprehensive summary of the active or specified sheet: used area, column headers, charts, merged cells, annotations, and shapes.

calc.name: read_cell_range
calc.description: Reads values from the specified cell range(s). Inspection only — keep ranges small (headers or a few dozen cells). A large dump overloads chat context; for bulk work write =PY(..., DataRange) instead of reading the block.

calc.name: write_formula_range
calc.description: To run Python on sheet data, write =PY("result = …"; DataRange) into one empty cell outside DataRange (e.g. J1 for A1:H500, or a new sheet). Do not dump the input or full spill into chat; do not write =PY onto DataRange (circular).

calc.name: sort_range
calc.description: Sorts the specified range(s) by a column.

calc.name: set_style
calc.description: Set cell style properties on a range.
